name: Render Data
description: Rendering settings for a Scene data-block

props.name: Resolution X
props.description: Number of horizontal pixels in the rendered image

props.name: Resolution Y
props.description: Number of vertical pixels in the rendered image

props.name: Resolution Scale
props.description: Percentage scale for render resolution

props.name: Pixel Size
props.description: Pixel size for viewport rendering

items.name: Automatic
items.description: Automatic pixel size, depends on the user interface scale
Render at full resolution
Render at 50% resolution
Render at 25% resolution
Render at 12.5% resolution

props.name: Pixel Aspect X
props.description: Horizontal aspect ratio - for anamorphic or non-square pixel output

props.name: Pixel Aspect Y
props.description: Vertical aspect ratio - for anamorphic or non-square pixel output

props.name: PPM Factor
props.description: The pixel density meta-data written to supported image formats. This value is multiplied by the PPM-base which defines the unit (typically inches or meters)

props.name: PPM Base
props.description: The base unit for pixels per meter.

props.name: FFmpeg Settings
props.description: FFmpeg related settings for the scene

props.name: FPS
props.description: Framerate, expressed in frames per second

props.name: FPS Base
props.description: Framerate base

props.name: Frame Map Old
props.description: Old mapping value in frames

props.name: Frame Map New
props.description: How many frames the Map Old will last

props.name: Dither Intensity
props.description: Amount of dithering noise added to the rendered image to break up banding

props.name: Filter Size
props.description: Width over which the reconstruction filter combines samples

props.name: Transparent
props.description: World background is transparent, for compositing the render over another background

props.name: Use Freestyle
props.description: Draw stylized strokes using Freestyle

props.name: Threads
props.description: Maximum number of CPU cores to use simultaneously while rendering (for multi-core/CPU systems)

props.name: Threads Mode
props.description: Determine the amount of render threads used

items.name: Auto-Detect
items.description: Automatically determine the number of threads, based on CPUs

items.name: Fixed
items.description: Manually determine the number of threads

props.name: Motion Blur
props.description: Use multi-sampled 3D scene motion blur

props.name: Shutter
props.description: Time taken in frames between shutter open and close

props.name: Motion Blur Position
props.description: Offset for the shutter's time interval, allows to change the motion blur trails

items.name: Start on Frame
items.description: The shutter opens at the current frame

items.name: Center on Frame
items.description: The shutter is open during the current frame

items.name: End on Frame
items.description: The shutter closes at the current frame

props.name: Shutter Curve
props.description: Curve defining the shutter's openness over time

props.name: Curves Shape Type
props.description: Curves shape type

props.name: Additional Subdivision
props.description: Additional subdivision along the curves

props.name: High Quality Normals
props.description: Use high quality tangent space at the cost of lower performance

props.name: Anisotropic Filtering
props.description: Quality of anisotropic filtering in materials

items.name: Off
items.description: Turn off anisotropic filtering
Use 2 samples for anisotropic filtering
Use 4 samples for anisotropic filtering
Use 8 samples for anisotropic filtering
Use 16 samples for anisotropic filtering

props.name: Render Region
props.description: Render a user-defined render region, within the frame size

props.name: Region Minimum X
props.description: Minimum X value for the render region

props.name: Region Minimum Y
props.description: Minimum Y value for the render region

props.name: Region Maximum X
props.description: Maximum X value for the render region

props.name: Region Maximum Y
props.description: Maximum Y value for the render region

props.name: Crop to Render Region
props.description: Crop the rendered frame to the defined render region size

props.name: Placeholders
props.description: Create empty placeholder files while rendering frames (similar to Unix 'touch')

props.name: Overwrite
props.description: Overwrite existing files while rendering

props.name: Save Output
props.description: Write frames to disk for animation renders

props.name: Compositing
props.description: Process the render result through the compositing pipeline, if a compositing node group is assigned to the scene

props.name: Sequencer
props.description: Process the render (and composited) result through the video sequence editor pipeline, if sequencer strips exist

props.name: File Extensions
props.description: Add the file format extensions to the rendered file name (eg: filename + .jpg)

props.name: Extension
props.description: The file extension used for saving renders

props.name: Movie Format
props.description: When true the format is a movie

props.name: Lock Interface
props.description: Lock interface during rendering in favor of giving more memory to the renderer

props.name: Output Path
props.description: Directory/name to save animations, # characters define the position and padding of frame numbers

props.name: Cache Result
props.description: Save render cache to EXR files (useful for heavy compositing, Note: affects indirectly rendered scenes)

props.name: Stamp Time
props.description: Include the rendered frame timecode as HH:MM:SS.FF in image metadata

props.name: Stamp Date
props.description: Include the current date in image/video metadata

props.name: Stamp Frame
props.description: Include the frame number in image metadata

props.name: Stamp Frame
props.description: Include the rendered frame range in image/video metadata

props.name: Stamp Camera
props.description: Include the name of the active camera in image metadata

props.name: Stamp Lens
props.description: Include the active camera's lens in image metadata

props.name: Stamp Scene
props.description: Include the name of the active scene in image/video metadata

props.name: Stamp Note
props.description: Include a custom note in image/video metadata

props.name: Stamp Marker
props.description: Include the name of the last marker in image metadata

props.name: Stamp Filename
props.description: Include the .blend filename in image/video metadata

props.name: Stamp Sequence Strip
props.description: Include the name of the foreground sequence strip in image metadata

props.name: Stamp Render Time
props.description: Include the render time in image metadata

props.name: Stamp Note Text
props.description: Custom text to appear in the stamp note

props.name: Stamp Output
props.description: Render the stamp info text in the rendered image

props.name: Stamp Labels
props.description: Display stamp labels ("Camera" in front of camera name, etc.)

props.name: Metadata Input
props.description: Where to take the metadata from

items.name: Scene
items.description: Use metadata from the current scene

items.name: Sequencer Strips
items.description: Use metadata from the strips in the sequencer

props.name: Stamp Peak Memory
props.description: Include the peak memory usage in image metadata

props.name: Stamp Hostname
props.description: Include the hostname of the machine that rendered the frame

props.name: Font Size
props.description: Size of the font used when rendering stamp text

props.name: Text Color
props.description: Color to use for stamp text

props.name: Background
props.description: Color to use behind stamp text

props.name: Sequencer Preview Shading
props.description: Display method used in the sequencer view

items.name: Wireframe
items.description: Display only edges of geometry without surface shading

items.name: Solid
items.description: Display objects with flat lighting and basic surface shading

items.name: Material Preview
items.description: Preview materials using predefined environment lights

items.name: Rendered
items.description: Preview the final scene using the active render engine

props.name: Override Scene Settings
props.description: Use Workbench render and world settings from the sequencer scene, instead of each strip's scene

props.name: Render Single Layer
props.description: Only render the active layer. Only affects rendering from the interface, ignored for rendering from command line.

props.name: Multiple Views
props.description: Use multiple views in the scene

items.name: Stereo 3D
items.description: Single stereo camera system, adjust the stereo settings in the camera panel

items.name: Multi-View
items.description: Multi camera system, adjust the cameras individually

props.name: Engine
props.description: Engine to use for rendering

props.name: Multiple Engines
props.description: More than one rendering engine is available

props.name: Use Spherical Stereo
props.description: Active render engine supports spherical stereo rendering

props.name: Use Simplify
props.description: Enable simplification of scene for quicker preview renders

props.name: Simplify Subdivision
props.description: Global maximum subdivision level

props.name: Simplify Child Particles
props.description: Global child particles percentage

props.name: Simplify Subdivision
props.description: Global maximum subdivision level during rendering

props.name: Simplify Child Particles
props.description: Global child particles percentage during rendering

props.name: Simplify Volumes
props.description: Resolution percentage of volume objects in viewport

props.name: Mesh Normals
props.description: Skip computing custom normals and face corner normals for displaying meshes in the viewport

props.name: Texture Cache
props.description: Load texture tiles at appropriate resolution on demand to reduce memory usage. This avoids loading all textures into memory, at the cost of extra disk space and some performance

props.name: Auto Generate Texture Cache
props.description: Automatically create tx files from image files when rendering, if the files do not exist or are outdated. The path to store the texture cache files is configured in the preferences

props.name: Simplify
props.description: Simplify Grease Pencil drawing

props.name: Playback Only
props.description: Simplify Grease Pencil only during animation playback

props.name: Antialiasing
props.description: Use Antialiasing to smooth stroke edges

props.name: Fill
props.description: Display fill strokes in the viewport

props.name: Modifiers
props.description: Display modifiers

props.name: Shader Effects
props.description: Display Shader Effects

props.name: Layers Tinting
props.description: Display layer tint

props.name: Persistent Data
props.description: Keep render data around for faster re-renders and animation renders, at the cost of increased memory usage

props.name: Line Thickness Mode
props.description: Line thickness mode for Freestyle line drawing

items.name: Absolute
items.description: Specify unit line thickness in pixels

items.name: Relative
items.description: Unit line thickness is scaled by the proportion of the present vertical image resolution to 480 pixels

props.name: Line Thickness
props.description: Line thickness in pixels

props.name: Compositor Device
props.description: Set how compositing is executed

props.name: Compositor Precision
props.description: The precision of compositor intermediate result

items.name: Auto
items.description: Full precision for final renders, half precision otherwise

items.name: Full
items.description: Full precision

props.name: Compositor Denoise Node Device
props.description: The device to use to process the denoise nodes in the compositor

items.name: Auto
items.description: Use the same device used by the compositor to process the denoise node

items.name: CPU
items.description: Use the CPU to process the denoise node

items.name: GPU
items.description: Use the GPU to process the denoise node if available, otherwise fallback to CPU

props.name: Compositor Preview Denoise Quality
props.description: The quality used by denoise nodes during viewport and interactive compositing if the nodes' quality option is set to Follow Scene

items.name: High
items.description: High quality

items.name: Balanced
items.description: Balanced between performance and quality

items.name: Fast
items.description: High performance

props.name: Compositor Final Denoise Quality
props.description: The quality used by denoise nodes during the compositing of final renders if the nodes' quality option is set to Follow Scene

items.name: High
items.description: High quality

items.name: Balanced
items.description: Balanced between performance and quality

items.name: Fast
items.description: High performance

funcs.description: Return the absolute path to the filename to be written for a given frame

params.description: Frame number to use, if unset the current frame will be used

params.name: View
params.description: The name of the view to use to replace the "%" chars

returns.name: File Path
returns.description: The resulting filepath from the scenes render settings
